message:
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], apologies for that. Please allow me a moment to check the files, and I’ll send them again shortly.

Thank you for being patient, and I appreciate you alerting me to the issue.

Thank you for sending these. Does the fixed cost also cover establishing our brand colours and fonts? The lettering on the truck—the light up words 'Global Dough Truck'—uses 'Clab', although we do not necessarily want or need that same font for the logo. We hope to hire you, but wanted to double-check that colour and font guidelines could also be produced.
Yes, definitely. The fixed cost covers the brand colors and font too, giving you everything required to keep the brand identity consistent going forward.
Could you let me know whether you have a particular completion timeline in mind for this project? I’m ready to begin immediately.

Hi, thank you for clearing that up. There’s no urgent rush because we’re both occupied with our day to day work while also trying to kickstart this start up, but would completion within the next 2 weeks work for you? We still need to complete your hire contract, so please bear with us!

Yes, that timing is perfect.
I’m looking forward to receiving the contract.
Thank you for making the offer. I’ll come back to you with the initial concepts.

Hi, before you begin developing concepts, we’ll send over some concepts that appeal to us, though naturally we also want to see your own ideas. Please hold off on starting the concepts until we’ve got back to you. Thanks, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

Of course; that approach sounds excellent. Whenever you’re ready, please send me the concepts or references you like, and I’ll examine them carefully before beginning the creative work.

I’m excited to see what has inspired you and then blend that with my own ideas to produce something distinctive and memorable for your brand.
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], I’m looking forward to seeing the inspiration concepts.
Hi, please bear with us! It’s been that kind of week, but we haven’t forgotten.
Sure, looking forward to it.

Hi, [FREELANCER_NAME_001] attached a draft logo made using AI—we were obviously only tinkering around with chat gpt. That said, we want fresh, original ideas, which is why we posted our proposal, although we do like those colours because they fit the look and feel of the Global Dough truck. The company is called 'Global Dough', so the logo should not contain the word 'truck'. The 'truck' component is only one area of the business. Put another way, 'Global Dough', the business needing the logo, will run a mobile catering truck, sell food online, and may also sell to other caterers/kitchens. This is why the business name is simply 'Global Dough', while the strapline stays the same. Are you happy to discuss anything before accepting the offer?
This is the truck, although, as noted above, the business encompasses more than only this.
Understood. I’ll develop a few concepts that closely reflect your vision, while introducing a creative element so the designs remain unique and visually appealing.
My usual preference is to accept the offer once [FREELANCER_NAME_001] shared the initial drafts, because that allows clients to assess the direction first and be fully comfortable before proceeding.

However, I’m flexible and glad to follow whichever arrangement makes you most comfortable. I can accept the offer after I present the initial concepts if that is your preference, or I can accept it right away if you would rather—I’m fine with either option.
Yes, let’s follow your approach and review the intial drafts first. Thank you
Thank you.

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], please review the initial drafts and share your thoughts with me. I’d be very interested to receive your feedback.

If you want any revisions, refinements, iterations, or changes, please feel free to say so. I’m happy to continue working with you until the result aligns perfectly with your vision.

Hi, many thanks for these. Matt (my partner - who is the chef and the creator of the business!!) and I have reviewed them. [FREELANCER_NAME_001] attached our feedback in a powerpoint, and hopefully everything is clear. If you’re uncertain about anything we mean, please let me know. All best, [CLIENT_NAME_001]
Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001], thank you for providing the feedback. I’ll go through your comments and return with the revised designs.
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], could you please take a look and share your feedback with me?

Thank you for these. We like the graduated orange colour and the lines beside the strapline.

Our preferences are the 1st and 3rd one, since the font used in the 2nd one feels too plain. However, someone unfamiliar with our name might not understand that the flame in the 3rd one represents an ‘O’, even though we like it.

Perhaps the flame could sit inside an ‘O’, be reshaped to look more like an ‘O’, or be superimposed over an ‘O’. Could you test all of those suggestions?

For logo 3, could we also see how it looks with ‘dough’ made slightly larger? To make the strapline more prominent, could you either outline every letter with a thin black pencil line or slightly brighten the orange tones used in the strapline lettering? We like the global dough font because it has character, particularly the G. We wondered whether a little ‘character’ could be added to a couple of the other letters, but thought it would be better to handle the revisions one stage at a time, as the existing font may be okay. Thank you—we’re moving in the right direction.
Thanks for the feedback. I’ll examine it and contact you if any questions come up.
Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], [FREELANCER_NAME_001] applied the feedback. Please look through the revised designs and tell me what you think.
Thanks for sending these. We’ve simply been swamped with work, so we’ll respond over the weekend.
Sure, take your time.

Hi, apologies for taking so long to respond.

Matt prefers number 4, where the strapline matches the colour of ‘global’ and both use graduated colours.

I was wondering, though, whether you could add a little more character to the ‘global dough’ font. The food will be genuinely authentic and freshly cooked, featuring flavours from around the world. I like the unusual shape of the ‘G’ in both words; could a similar treatment be applied to more letters without taking it too far? thanks, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], certainly! I’ll review it, explore what’s possible, and come back to you with a revised draft.
Thank you.

I think these two options represent roughly the greatest amount of character that can be introduced without harming the logo’s overall readability and quality. Adding more than this would begin to undermine the clean, refined appearance and reduce its versatility across different uses.

My focus has been on bringing subtle personality into the letterforms while retaining the brand’s premium and authentic feel. In my view, this adds a distinctive quality without sacrificing the logo’s professionalism or overall balance.
Please take a look and share your thoughts with me.

Hi, thanks for these. We’re nearly there!
1\. For the second logo, please reduce the size of the U and the H so they match the height of all the other letters in ‘ DOUGH’.
2\. Could you flip the top on the right hand side of the H in DOUGH, making it mirror the top of the U in DOUGH?
3\. Lastly, could you apply the same feature to the top of the D in DOUGH, similar to the top of the B in GLOBAL?
Please refer to the attached annotated screenshot.
After that, we’ll review it again and hopefully it will retain the ‘clean’ appearance while also having the character.
Many thanks, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

Of course. I’ll apply those changes and send you the revised design.
Please review.

Hi, oops—I thought I had already replied!

We’d like to proceed with the agreed final version shown above, rev4-02. Thank you!

Am I correct in assuming that the logo will be supplied both with and without the black box, since a black box will not be suitable for every use?

Will we also receive every colour variant you’ve presented?

That said, I believe the primary logo should be the version in the top row of the final design: graduated orange ‘global’, black ‘dough’, and the strapline in graduated orange.

What we now need is the logo guidelines and every file type required for use online, on social media, on the truck itself, and across other hard copy materials, eg pull up banners, printed menus, uniform, etc.

Given that the files will have large file sizes, how will you share them? Wetransfer?

Thank you, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001], excellent! When convenient, could you approve the first milestone and activate the second, allowing me to proceed with the outstanding work?

Yes, the logo will be supplied with the black box and without it.

For the color variants, are you requesting every color version considered during the design process, or only the standard full-color, black, and white versions?

I’ll provide all required file formats as well, including fully editable source files, enabling you to use the logo for print, web, social media, signage, merchandise, and any other purpose. The final delivery will also contain the font information and color codes used in the chosen design.

I did want to clarify that logo guidelines were not part of the original project scope, as they are generally supplied through a separate project.

There are two options:

Basic Logo Usage Guidelines – $100
Covers logo variations, clear space, minimum size, color palette, typography, and basic do's and don'ts.

Complete Brand Guidelines – $150
Contains everything offered in the basic guide, along with a broader brand system addressing typography hierarchy, imagery style, iconography, layout principles, brand applications, stationery and t-shirt mockups, and detailed usage rules.

I’d be happy to produce either option if you wish, helping ensure the logo is applied consistently and professionally to all future branding materials.

Hi, did you receive the first $75, and has the second $75 been released? I’m uncertain whether [FREELANCER_NAME_001] completed everything necessary to release the second amount, so I’ll check again.

Perhaps guidelines isn’t the right term. Earlier in our conversation, you said, “Yes, absolutely. The fixed cost includes the brand colors and font as well, so you'll have everything needed to maintain a consistent brand identity moving forward.” That is probably what I’m referring to.

For the colour versions, we only need the three you mentioned above.

Thanks, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

The first milestone has been released. Before the second milestone can be released, it must first be activated/funded.

Yes, if you are referring to the brand colors and fonts, those will be included in the final files at no extra cost, as agreed.

Certainly, I’ll provide those color versions too.
Should be released now?

It has now been activated, and you can release it after I deliver the final files.
I’ll submit the final files within an hour.
[FREELANCER_NAME_001] released the final payment in the meantime, although I won’t have an opportunity to review everything until tomorrow evening.

That’s no problem; please take as much time as you need to review everything.

After you’re fully satisfied with the final deliverables, I’d be very grateful if you could close the contract. I am expecting a 5-star rating together with a few words of positive feedback. It would be very meaningful to me and would provide significant help to my profile.

Thank you once again. If any final adjustments are required, I’ll be glad to assist.

Hi, [FREELANCER_NAME_001] only now found the time to sit down and open the files on my laptop. Unfortunately, the colour codes doc will not open because it displays an error. The jpgs and pdfs open without any problems, but I’m unable to open the AI, EPS, or PSD files. For the png files, only logo 4 opens correctly; none of the others open properly. Also, when we create the website and other materials, which font should we use? Did you use an existing font, or did you create it? If you created it, which font would complement the logo or potentially match it for uses such as some headers? Thanks, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

Thank you for reviewing the files and reporting the problems.

The PSD file requires Adobe Photoshop to open, while Adobe Illustrator—or another compatible vector editing program—is needed for the AI and EPS files. Without those applications installed, the files won't open as intended.

I'll investigate the PNG files that aren't opening correctly and provide fixed versions.

Regarding the font, all of the logo lettering was custom-made rather than derived from a particular font. However, I can recommend a closely similar font that pairs well with the logo and would work for the website, headings, and other branding materials while keeping the visual identity consistent.

Let me know if you'd like me to recommend a few font options.

Hi, thank you for explaining. I’m also unable to open the colour codes doc. I’ll wait to hear back from you about the PNG files. If helpful, I can send screenshots later showing what I see when I try to open them. And yes, it would be great if you could suggest fonts that complement the logo. Thanks, [CLIENT_NAME_001]

Hi [CLIENT_NAME_001],

Thank you for the update. That’s no problem at all. I'll send the colour codes document again and investigate the PNG files. If I'm still unable to determine the cause, I'll ask you to provide screenshots later.

I'll also compile a few font suggestions that work well with the logo and send them to you shortly.

Thanks!
Thank you — could you also provide written confirmation that we own the copyright, so we can trademark the logo in due course and get all those boxes ticked?

You're welcome! Yes, I can create a Copyright Transfer Certificate stating that the copyright has been assigned to you. You can retain it for your records and use it when submitting a trademark application.

Preparing the certificate carries an additional charge of $50. Please tell me if you want me to proceed, and I'll prepare it for you.
Could you please email a draft/template certificate so that I can confirm the wording is sufficient?
Could you provide your email address so that I can send you the draft certificate?
Could you provide the full name and address you would like included in the trademark certificate?

[FREELANCER_NAME_001] checked the PNG files, and the logos are opening properly. What’s happening is that the background color blends into sections of the logo, which makes it look like the logo isn’t displaying correctly.

Zooming in will allow you to see the text and logo clearly. A simple way to verify this is by dragging and dropping the PNG file into any web browser or paint app. It should display correctly there, allowing you to view it without any issues.

Please let me know after you’ve checked.

Here are my suggestions for similar fonts:

Fonts Name:

Intervogue Soft Alt Black

Haboro Soft Normal Extra Bold
Here are the Color codes.
Hey [CLIENT_NAME_001], could you provide your email address so I can send the certificate script to you?
Gosh, sorry — I forgot because there’s a lot happening our end. Pls send it to [EMAIL_001]
I understand. I’m sending the email to you right now, so please review it and let me know.
Yep, I’ll do that when I can.
Would you like me to share it there as well?
Just shared that here also.
Could you also add and activate the milestone for the certificate, please?
Thank you. Please take a look at your email.

Hi, the certificate is here.

Would you please close the contract? I’m expecting a 5-star rating along with a positive review.

I enjoyed working with you and hope we’ll have another opportunity to collaborate in the future. Thank you!

Would you please close the contract? I’m expecting a 5-star rating along with a positive review.

I enjoyed working with you and hope we’ll have another opportunity to collaborate in the future. Thank you!
